PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits Clara's clue ("She was beside the table. She was not sitting in a chair."). So Clara (C) must be at row 6, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Delia's clue ("She was beside the plant. She was in a corner of her area.") fits only one square. So Delia (D) must be at row 4, column 7. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Suppose Fergus were at row 7, column 1: then Fergus's clue ("Someone else in his area was beside a lamppost.") could not be true. So Fergus can't be there. Bonnie can't be at row 1, column 1; row 1, column 2; row 1, column 3: in each case Amos would have nowhere left to go. Testing the remaining squares the same way rules out a few more. Fergus's own clue ("Someone else in his area was beside a lamppost.") rules out more squares. So Fergus (F) must be at row 7, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Suppose Amos were at row 5, column 6: then Amos's clue ("He was exactly two rows south of Vaughn.") could not be true. So Amos can't be there. Amos is now the only person who can still go in column 6. So Amos (A) must be at row 3, column 6. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Suppose Bonnie were at row 5, column 4: then Fergus would have nowhere left to go. So Bonnie can't be there. So Bonnie (B) must be at row 2, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: Emil is now the only person who can still go in row 5. So Emil (E) must be at row 5, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vaughn. So Vaughn (the victim) must be at row 1, column 4. Cross out his row and column. Amos is the only person in the Bar with Vaughn, so Amos is the murderer!
